# Task family reference

A task family is one code-agent task written once with knobs, in `family.yaml`, beside its oracle and the review a person signs; see [task families](../generating.md#task-families). `driftbench family instances`, `verify` and `review` read these files. The family file comes first, then the review file. The page lists every field, generated from the zod schemas the CLI uses.

* Keys are snake_case. An unknown key is an error.
* Descriptions come from the schemas. An empty cell means the schema has no description for that field yet.

## FamilyFile

A code-agent task family.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `1` | yes |  | The format version of the family file: 1. |
| `id` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$` | yes |  | An id: letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens. |
| `title` | string, not empty | yes |  | A short title. |
| `description` | string, not empty | yes |  | What the task asks of the agent, for the reviewer. |
| `target` | [FamilyFile target](#familyfile-target) | yes |  | The agent every instance runs against. |
| `spec` | [FamilyFile spec](#familyfile-spec) | yes |  | Fields copied into every instance spec. |
| `oracle` | string, not empty | yes |  | The oracle module beside the family file: it exports expected(input). |
| `review` | string, not empty | yes |  | The review file beside the family file, signed once by a person. |
| `knobs` | map of string to [Knob](#knob) | yes |  | The knobs, by name: what varies from one instance to the next. |
| `constraints` | list of [Constraint](#constraint) | no | `[]` | Rules every drawn set of knobs must meet; a draw that breaks one is drawn again. |
| `wording_knob` | string matching `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` | yes |  | The style knob whose value picks the phrase of every part. |
| `tables` | map of string to [Table](#table) | yes |  | The tables the seed files render, by name. |
| `files` | list of [SeedFile](#seedfile), at least 1 item | yes |  | The files of the workspace seed. |
| `corners` | [FamilyFile corners](#familyfile-corners) | yes |  | The corner-case variants of each instance, chosen by the instance seed. |
| `phrases` | list of [Phrase](#phrase), at least 1 item | yes |  | An approved phrase: the only text an instance can hold. |
| `blocks` | list of [BlockDef](#blockdef), at least 1 item | yes |  | The blocks of every instance, in order. |
| `checks` | [CheckVocabulary](#checkvocabulary) | yes |  | Per file kind, the reader checks the expected files compile to; each must be a check of that reader. |
| `others_untouched` | boolean | no | `true` | True: every block also expects that no path other than those the oracle names changes. |
| `planted` | [Planted](#planted) | no |  | A variant whose workspace holds an instruction planted in a file: the expected outcome stays the same. |

## Knob

Write one of these forms.

* [RangeKnob](#rangeknob)
* [EnumKnob](#enumknob)

## RangeKnob

A whole number between min and max, both included.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `class` | [KnobClass](#knobclass) | yes |  | difficulty, structure or style: what kind of change the knob makes. |
| `description` | string | no |  | What the knob changes, for the reviewer. |
| `min` | integer | yes |  | The smallest value, included. |
| `max` | integer | yes |  | The largest value, included. |

## KnobClass

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `difficulty` | A count: rows, files or sheets. |
| `structure` | A shape: a format, a layout, a kind of formula, or a path the outcome holds. |
| `style` | A surface choice the outcome must not depend on: the wording, an order, line endings, the name of a file the task never names, or the language. `family instances` rebuilds every variant with each other value of each style knob and writes nothing when the expected outcome changes. |

## EnumKnob

One value of a list.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `class` | [KnobClass](#knobclass) | yes |  | difficulty, structure or style: what kind of change the knob makes. |
| `description` | string | no |  | What the knob changes, for the reviewer. |
| `values` | list of strings, each not empty, at least 1 item | yes |  | The values, in the order the reviewer reads them. |

## Planted

A variant whose workspace holds an instruction planted in a file: the expected outcome stays the same.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `knob` | string matching `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` | yes |  | The variant exists when this knob holds "with". |

| `phrase` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$` | yes |  | The planted text, an approved phrase. |

| `safety` | map of string to any value | no |  | Safety expectations added to the block in the planted variant. |
